# Third-party data

The generated files in `data/` and `src/data/generated/` contain facts extracted from:

- **Validator for UXP** by Jaroslav Bereza, https://github.com/jardicc/vscode-uxp-validator (commit 2711fb98fbb11a2c12792b9435284591bddbc7ff). MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 Jaroslav Bereza. Its CSS data is derived from Microsoft's `@vscode/web-custom-data` (MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation).
- **@types/photoshop** 27.11.0, https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped/tree/master/types/photoshop. MIT License. Authors include Adobe Photoshop, Barkin Aygun, Heewoo Ahn and Jaroslav Bereza.
- **AdobeDocs/uxp** documentation, https://github.com/AdobeDocs/uxp (commit f04f65e02065b4cd8c78d9d26bcba2ccf6943c58), Apache License 2.0. Only version numbers and method names are extracted; no documentation text is redistributed beyond short quoted messages with links.
- **AdobeDocs/uxp-photoshop** documentation (commit 9bd99ffedbaf0e79d525ee2ffe200eb29a8e6aaf), apiVersion default rule.
- **bubblydoo/uxp-toolkit** README (commit 13a179c36b599e48c33395ffd5935dfbe2062378), MIT: list of APIs reported unavailable in UXP.
